title: kith-tui: UI rendering (ui.rs)
description:
What: Implement ui.rs with the draw() function that renders the full 3-panel layout using placeholder data from AppState.

Algorithm:
1. pub fn draw(f: &mut ratatui::Frame, state: &AppState)
2. Vertical split of f.area() into 3 parts:
   - top: Constraint::Fill(1)
   - input_area: Constraint::Length(3)
   - status_area: Constraint::Length(1)
3. Horizontal split of top into 2 parts:
   - chat_list_area: Constraint::Percentage(25)
   - message_area: Constraint::Fill(1)
4. Chat list panel: render List widget with state.chat_list items as ListItem; highlight selected_chat with Style::default().add_modifier(Modifier::REVERSED); border Block::default().title("Chats").borders(Borders::ALL), yellow border when focus==Focus::ChatList
5. Message thread panel: render Paragraph with state.messages lines formatted as Line items; scroll to show bottom (apply scroll_offset); border Block::default().title("Messages").borders(Borders::ALL)
6. Input panel: render Paragraph with state.input text; border Block::default().title("Input").borders(Borders::ALL), yellow border when focus==Focus::Input; set cursor position with f.set_cursor_position() when focused
7. Status bar: render Paragraph with Span::raw(" [placeholder]") on dark gray background
8. Cursor position: input_area.x + 1 + visible_cursor_col, input_area.y + 1; visible_cursor_col = UnicodeWidthStr::width(&state.input[..state.input_cursor]) as u16

Defensive programming rules:
- Guard against zero-size areas: if area.width < 4 || area.height < 4, skip rendering that panel
- Use saturating_sub for all area dimension calculations
- No unwrap()

Tests (unit):
- test: draw() does not panic on a 80x24 area (use ratatui::backend::TestBackend)
- test: draw() does not panic on minimum area 20x10
- Oracle for both tests: TestBackend::new(w, h) + Terminal::new(backend) allows calling draw() synchronously; no panic = pass
